title: Travel with your pet
description: A fully animated explainer film for Interfamily, a platform facilitating international family connections and support services for Latin American families with relatives working or studying abroad. The film simplifies a complex emotional and logistical proposition into a clear, warm visual story.
challenge: Interfamily's service addresses a genuinely complex human need — maintaining family bonds across borders while navigating practical and legal challenges. The brief required the film to feel emotionally resonant without being sentimental, and informative without being dry.
solution: Built around character-driven 2D animation with a warm, hand-crafted aesthetic. The visual style deliberately avoids the clean-but-cold look of most fintech animation, opting instead for textured illustration and fluid transitions that mirror the human warmth of the brand's mission.
result: The explainer film became Interfamily's primary conversion asset on their landing page, increasing contact form submissions by 38% in the month following launch.
